brief: How to position a brand so customers can't ignore you — 6 lessons.

slots.headline: How to position a brand nobody can ignore
slots.swipeNote: Swipe to see the 6 lessons in positioning

slots.title: Pick one hill to die on
slots.body: Clarity beats cleverness. The brands that win own one unmistakable idea in the customer's mind. If you stand for everything, you stand for nothing.

slots.title: Niche down until it hurts
slots.body: Mass appeal is a myth. Speak directly to the smallest viable audience and watch them rally around you. Specificity creates loyalty.

slots.title: Polarize to magnetize your people
slots.body: Safe brands are invisible. Take a stand that repels some to deeply attract others. Strong opinions drive word of mouth.

slots.title: Show proof, not just promise
slots.body: Claims without evidence dissolve trust. Share real results, stories, and specifics that make your promise feel inevitable. Proof sells.

slots.title: Anchor against a common enemy
slots.body: Define what you fight against. Contrast sharpens your value and gives customers a reason to choose you. Context matters.

slots.title: Make the customer the hero
slots.body: Your brand is the guide, not the hero. Frame your customer as the protagonist and your product as their weapon.

slots.quote: Be so specific they can't ignore you
slots.headline: Start building your unignorable brand today
